slides.title: 5 verses for when family pressure hits
slides.body:
For the wedding questions, the comparisons
and the silence after you say no.

slides.text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
slides.label: When you love them and still feel hurt
slides.eyebrow: 1 / 5  ·  When you love them and still feel hurt
slides.r10_context: Exodus 20:12 is the fifth commandment, given to Israel at Sinai: honour father and mother. Used for: pressure does not cancel honour, and honour does not require agreeing with every demand. Not used to say parents are always right.

slides.text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
slides.label: When the question comes again
slides.r10_context: Proverbs 15:1-4 are sayings about speech: a soft answer turns away wrath, harsh words stir anger. Used for: answering a pressing relative gently. Not used to say you must stay silent.

slides.text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
slides.label: When they say you're running late
slides.eyebrow: 3 / 5  ·  When they say you're running late
slides.r10_context: Ecclesiastes 3:1-8: God has appointed seasons for every matter under heaven. Used for: your life's timing is not set by the family's clock. Not a promise that a marriage, job or child will come by a date.

slides.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
slides.label: Before you reply to the family group
slides.eyebrow: 4 / 5  ·  Before you reply to the family group
slides.r10_context: Philippians 4:4-7: Paul tells the church not to be anxious but to bring every request to God in prayer with thanksgiving, and God's peace will guard their hearts. Used for: take the pressure to God before answering. Matches.

slides.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
slides.label: When you're tired of carrying everyone's expectations
slides.eyebrow: 5 / 5  ·  When you're tired of carrying everyone's expectations
slides.r10_context: Matthew 11:28-30: Jesus invites the weary and burdened to come to Him for rest and take His easy yoke (contrasted with heavy burdens laid on people). Used for: the weight of others' expectations can be brought to Jesus. Not used to say family duties stop mattering.

slides.title: Send this to the one who dreads the next family function.
slides.body: Save it for the next time they ask.

caption:
5 Bible verses for when family pressure hits. Save this for the next wedding, the next comparison, the next silence.

1. When you love them and still feel hurt: Exodus 20:12 (KJV)
2. When the question comes again: Proverbs 15:1 (KJV)
3. When they say you're running late: Ecclesiastes 3:1 (KJV)
4. Before you reply to the family group: Philippians 4:6 (KJV)
5. When you're tired of carrying everyone's expectations: Matthew 11:28 (KJV)
